entries.title: Closed tasks no longer leave evidence on another computer forever
entries.body: A week after a task closes, Firstmate removes its evidence and other leftover files on the computer that ran it, as it already does on this Mac. Files a live task still needs stay, and so do its conversation and cards. If that computer is out of reach or needs a Firstmate update, cleanup waits.
entries.noPicture: Cleanup changes files on disk, not a visible view.
